decisions.identity: Flair Showcase is the flagship successor to Flair. Single hobby series, 5 cards/pack, 24 packs/box.
decisions.checklist: 90 subjects in each of three normal rows and three Legacy rows; 20 Class of '96 and 20 Hot Shots; 580 pack-issued cards. All 90 base name/team pairs and 40 insert name/team pairs compared to Cardboard Connection and MyCardBatch. Parallel checklists mirror the 90-card sequence as documented by PSA/TCDB; distinct row designs must have their own authentic scans. Non-pack Jerry Stackhouse promo strip excluded.
decisions.rookies: 11 true RCs marked only in Row 2, consistent with TCDB base index; parallels and inserts omit RC designation.
decisions.odds: Historical within-row rarity preserved as card subset and manifest notes. Flatten within each 90-card collector-facing set. Row 1 rate cap 1:1 due to VCS one-hit per ProductSet engine; Row 0 aggregate approximated 1:3. Each Legacy row modeled 1:90 (combined expected 1:30, independent rolls permit occasional multiple hits); all 270 /150. Theoretical average insert count 1+1/3+3/90+1/5+1/90=1.5778 of 5 slots before any cap. The existing rip engine does not truncate excess insert hits: extremely rare simultaneous hits can yield more than five cards (approximately 0.000037% of packs under independent rolls). Review pack capacity before release; no engine change in this import. No pack-engine changes or pricing writes.
